lesson.title: Why do we have day and night?
lesson.o1: The Earth spins around its own axis, once every day.
lesson.o2: It is day on the side of the Earth facing the Sun, and night on the side facing away.
lesson.s1.title: The Sun and the Earth
lesson.s1.hello: Hello! Today we find out why we have day and night.
lesson.s1.sun: Here is the Sun. It gives us light.
lesson.s1.earth: And here is the Earth, where we live.
lesson.s1.sam-asks: Why doesn't the Sun go around us? It moves across the sky!
lesson.s1.answer: Good question, Sam! It looks like the Sun moves, but the Earth is spinning.
lesson.s1.spin: The Earth spins like a top, all the way round once every day.
lesson.s1.q-answer: Try this: spin slowly on the spot and watch the room seem to move around you.
lesson.s1.again: Let me show you the Sun and the Earth again.
lesson.s2.title: Day side and night side
lesson.s2.light: Light from the Sun only reaches one side of the Earth at a time.
lesson.s2.day: The side facing the Sun has day.
lesson.s2.night: The side facing away has night.
lesson.s2.sam: So when it is night for me, it is day for someone on the other side?
lesson.s3.title: Turn the Earth
lesson.s3.try: Now you try. Use the slider to spin the Earth, and watch the little yellow flag.
lesson.s3.night: Look: the flag is facing away from the Sun. It is night there now.
lesson.s3.tap: You can drag to look around, and tap the Sun, the Earth or the flag to see their names.
lesson.s3.hint: Slide it more than halfway, until the flag goes into the dark side.
lesson.s4.title: Check what you know
lesson.s4.intro: Three quick questions. Take your time; there are hints.
lesson.q1: Why do we have day and night?
lesson.q1.b: The Sun goes around the Earth
lesson.q2: When it is day where you are, what is it on the far side of the Earth?
lesson.q2.hint: Only one side faces the Sun at a time.
lesson.q3: How long does the Earth take to spin once?
lesson.q3.hint: One spin gives one day and one night.
lesson.retry: Nice try. Here is a hint.
learn.finished: You finished the lesson. Well done!
